newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - A. Brown ups Flextronics.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - A. Brown ups Flextronics.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown & Sons analyst Jim Savage said Friday he raised his rating on Flextronics International Ltd.
-- Savage left his earnings estimates unchanged, after raising them only last month following the company's earnings report for its second quarter ended September 30.

-- "I raised my rating because I think there is increasing visibility as to their ability to penetrate global OEMs," Savage said, referring to Flextronics' business as a contract manufacturer for leading computer and networking companies.
-- Flextronics corporate customers are referred to in industry jargon as OEMs, or Original Equipment Manufacturers.
